LanguageData.LF_Settings_Enabled_Desc: When disabled, NPC bases generate as in vanilla.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_ShowTier: Show rank in the world map inspect panel
LanguageData.LF_Settings_ExistingNote: Ranks are assigned when the world is created, or the first time a save is loaded with the mod. Changing max cities only affects new worlds.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_AutoMeasure: (Testing) Automatically measure performance in NPC bases
LanguageData.LF_Settings_AutoMeasure_Desc: Dev mode only. Measures 30 s when entering an NPC base and another 30 s when the defenders start their assault. Results go to Player.log.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_Waves: Reinforcement waves in cities and capitals
LanguageData.LF_Settings_Waves_Desc: Only part of the defenders are present at the start; the rest arrive in waves as the garrison takes losses. Reduces lag. Affects bases generated after the change.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_MaxActive_Desc: If more enemies are standing, the next wave waits. Lower values improve performance.
LanguageData.LF_WaveLetterText: Reinforcements from {0} arrive to defend their base: {1} fighters.
LanguageData.LF_WaveLetterTextLast: The last wave from {0} arrives: {1} fighters. If it falls, the base falls with it.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_AnimalFactor: Wild animals on NPC base maps: {0}
LanguageData.LF_Settings_AnimalFactor_Desc: Percentage of the biome normal amount. Fewer animals improves performance when attacking bases. Affects maps generated after the change.
LanguageData.LF_Settings_TribalPoints_Desc: Tribes have no turrets or mortars; their strength is numbers. Multiplies the points of their garrison and waves.
LanguageData.LF_CommanderLetter: The citadel of {0} is defended by {1} ({2}) and an elite guard, in the command hall.
LanguageData.LF_AmbushText: Warriors of {0} leap out of hiding and attack {2}: {1} fighters.
